release_recovery_inspection_contract.identity: exact original journal filename/UUID, supported release schema/phase, repository and ReleasePlan content hash, allocation, path, branch, HEAD and original CAS; referenced publication/intent identities must match
release_recovery_inspection_contract.evidence: raw SHA-256 and existing paths of the original journal and release plan, read under a shared repository lock
release_recovery_inspection_contract.release_argv: structured argument list for the existing guarded release, including original --publication-receipt-id and --intent-id when applicable; values are individual arguments, never a shell command
release_recovery_inspection_contract.authority: release_authorized=false and execution_guards_checked=false; no mutation, receipt creation, recovery execution, live guard preflight or activation exception; original owner/CAS come from the plan, never the released record; missing or inconsistent original evidence is refused

rollout_transaction_diagnostics_contract.unavailable_identity: command, phase and recovery_entry are null when not known; failed staged invocation diagnostics also have null transaction_id
rollout_transaction_diagnostics_contract.consumer: check-writer-rollout adds repository to each transaction_diagnostics row; controller-activate logs these rows before refusal
rollout_transaction_diagnostics_contract.classification: verified terminal evidence first; unfinished release requires the original release request, supported cleanup keeps its exact recovery checks, unknown commands or cleanup contracts remain refused
rollout_transaction_diagnostics_contract.authority: first refused transaction only; recovery_entry is a hint that still needs exact original identity and evidence; the check performs no metadata writes, automatic repair or new activation exception; release dry-run still refuses after checkout removal

canonical_refresh_contract.applies_to: an ACTIVE canonical checkout on the policy publication branch that is clean, holds no writer lease, runtime binding or unfinished transaction, and is used by no live process other than the caller's own ancestry
canonical_refresh_contract.action: fetch the publication branch and fast-forward canonical only when its HEAD is an ancestor; the published policy must remain governable; Controller metadata is unchanged
canonical_refresh_contract.frozen: a HANDOFF_READY canonical keeps the exact canonical-transition flow

process_diagnostics.identity: bounded current kernel stat metadata; missing, unreadable, malformed or oversized observations use unknown names/status and a null parent PID; parent metadata may independently be unknown
process_diagnostics.authority: advisory only; original process-path evidence keeps the refusal, even if identity disappears; no command arguments, environments, native session mutation or automatic process termination
process_diagnostics.retry: verify exact task/session ownership and other active shared-daemon work; normally close only the completed task-owned session; retry_argv requests guarded dry-run before refresh

canonical_transition_contract.identity: exact frozen record CAS, owner, branch, HEAD, old local main and expected remote main
canonical_transition_contract.mutation: fast-forward local main, checkout with ignored-file overwrite disabled, then activate the canonical control-plane record
canonical_transition_contract.recovery: retry exact pre-metadata ref or checkout progress; retain the frozen branch and its history evidence
canonical_transition_contract.guards: clean attached canonical, complete handoff, no lease/binding/open intent, ancestral target, unoccupied main and valid target policy

integration_keyed_document_scope_contrac.entry_points: normal enqueue, claim, reconcile and retry scope checks
integration_keyed_document_scope_contrac.identity: original frozen source commits, scopes and queue sequence; no mutable checkout evidence
integration_keyed_document_scope_contrac.supported_document: docs/handbook/business-progress.json, quant-platform schema 2, unchanged committed qp-handbook-progress merge profile
integration_keyed_document_scope_contrac.proof: unique non-ancestor merge base for every frozen source pair; whole-record changed keys must be disjoint across tasks.authority_key and development_lines/modules/decisions.id
integration_keyed_document_scope_contrac.bounds: at most 8 sources per intent, 2 MiB regular document blobs, 64 KiB attributes blobs
integration_keyed_document_scope_contrac.fail_closed: shared record, metadata/schema/order changes, broad paths, code overlap, duplicate keys, invalid/missing/oversized Git evidence, ancestry dependency, explicit prerequisite or earlier publishing/recovery/attention state
integration_keyed_document_scope_contrac.authority: preparation only; all ownership, resource admission, fresh candidate validation, main CAS and serialized publication gates remain

integration_lineage_admission_contract.entry_point: integration-claim through the original frozen integration intent
integration_lineage_admission_contract.identity: unchanged intent, source allocation/handoff/branch/Finalizer/Snapshot, scope and queue sequence
integration_lineage_admission_contract.admission: a different integration task may share its allocated feature/audit/hotfix/emergency source authority only after the repository producer verifies that exact frozen lineage under its lock; request fingerprints and durable source rows stay unchanged
integration_lineage_admission_contract.idempotency: an exact repeated claim of an unchanged clean PREPARING_INTEGRATION candidate observes its existing identity without allocating, reserving, emitting events, validating or granting publication authority
integration_lineage_admission_contract.guards: same-task request drift and unrelated shared-authority requests remain refused; scope fences and resource budgets remain enforced; RESOURCE_WAIT never reports a candidate as claimed

canonical_main_refresh_contract.entry_point: canonical-transition with expected branch equal to the policy publication branch (main or master)
canonical_main_refresh_contract.identity: exact frozen record CAS, owner and handoff HEAD, observed local main HEAD and expected remote main HEAD
canonical_main_refresh_contract.mutation: validate the immutable published policy, then fast-forward the checked-out main with ignored-file overwrite disabled; append CANONICAL_MAIN_REFRESHED and activate the control-plane record only after exact remote verification
canonical_main_refresh_contract.recovery: preserve advanced main and unchanged frozen metadata on interruption; retry with the observed local main HEAD, proving frozen HEAD -> observed main -> exact published target ancestry; never rewind main
canonical_main_refresh_contract.retained_evidence: the original handoff history and Finalizer identity; no extra baseline branch, release receipt or retirement proof
canonical_main_refresh_contract.guards: all canonical-transition guards remain; unpublished or divergent main, invalid published policy and ignored-file collisions fail closed

lock.name: repo.lock
lock.authority: regular readable-writable non-symlink file; every Controller mutation and the Git Finalizer retirement path serialize on it; missing or unusable locks fail closed

directories.records: one metadata record JSON per allocation id
directories.bindings: one worktree-key binding JSON per governed checkout
directories.transactions: nonterminal mutation journals; interrupted atomic temp siblings are never records
directories.namespace-migrations: write-once legacy namespace migration receipts, keyed by plan id
directories.registration-prune-receipts: write-once registration-prune/v1 audit receipts; authoritative terminal and recovery proof for registration pruning, not repository identity or lock authority; included byte-for-byte in namespace migration merged digest and move/convergence, but not in the prior GC plan digest or metadata-reference-relocation/v1 cleanup inventory
directories.branch-retirement-plans: versioned retirement plans consumed by the Git Finalizer retirement verifier
directories.branch-retirement-authorizations: single-use retirement execution grants and their immutable abandonment evidence
directories.cleanup-actions: per-transaction typed and preserved cleanup action evidence; used by earlier v4 runtimes and declared in v5
directories.cleanup-recoveries: per-transaction cleanup recovery records and terminal completions; used by earlier v4 runtimes and declared in v5
directories.native-session-recoveries: immutable archived native-session binding recovery evidence, one document per allocation record version; used by earlier v4 runtimes and declared in v5
directories.session-closeouts: session-closeout/v1 observations keyed by exact holder identity; a document whose holder is provably gone is pruned when another observation is written; used by earlier v4 runtimes and declared in v5
directories.binding-registrations: worktree-registration/v1 identity of each linked binding written from v5: allocation, Git administrative directory and token; the same token is written to <git-common-dir>/<admin_dir>/worktree-controller-registration, and a live administrative directory without the matching marker withdraws the binding as BINDING_IDENTITY_DRIFT

consumers: Git Finalizer retirement verifier (reads branch-retirement-plans under repo.lock)
storage_layout.compatibility: v5 declares four directories already used by earlier v4 runtimes (cleanup-actions, cleanup-recoveries, native-session-recoveries, session-closeouts) and adds exactly one directory (binding-registrations) plus the per-registration Git administrative marker worktree-controller-registration; no data moves and all v4 names, file identities and record and binding schemas remain unchanged; a binding without a registration document keeps its v4 meaning, v4 readers may ignore the added directory, and exact layout pins must recognize v5 before activation; v4 declares exactly one directory (registration-prune-receipts) already used by 1.9.2; no data moves and all v3 names, file identities and record schemas remain unchanged; v3 readers of existing paths may ignore the extra directory, while exact layout pins must recognize v4 before activation; v3 adds exactly one directory (namespace-migrations) and one documented previous-namespace entry (codex-worktree/v1, migrated only by the namespace-migrate verb); v2 adds exactly one directory (branch-retirement-authorizations); any further layout or schema change requires a new layout version plus that gate, and external consumers pin this section

branch_retirement_contract.authority: Controller eligibility and immutable plan; Git Finalizer local/remote ref mutation
consumer_contract: the Controller owns eligibility, plan identity, state digest and blocker policy
a consumer obtains a verdict from branch-retirement-verify or a grant from branch-retirement-authorize
an authorized run settles through branch-retirement-complete, never through a self-reported summary
external tools must not copy the canonicalization, digest recipe or blocker list
the consumer performs the Git compare-and-delete itself; the Controller never writes a ref
consumer-specific argument and summary vocabulary lives only in the compatibility adapter
a grant is single-use: verify reports RETIREMENT_AUTHORIZATION_ACTIVE for the granted operation only

identity.plan_id: sha256 over the canonical JSON encoding of the identity fields
identity.canonicalization: JSON object with keys sorted, ensure_ascii=false, separators (",",":"), UTF-8
identity.optional_identity_semantics: include an optional field only when present; release-backed plans retain their exact previous identity recipe
identity.excluded_from_identity: observed ref states, checkout paths, eligibility and blockers are live observations, not identity

state_digest.recipe: sha256 over, in this order: for each authority directory, each relevant *.json sorted by path, the update sequence is relative POSIX path, a NUL byte, the exact file bytes, a NUL byte; then each authority single file bound to the allocation with the same sequence prefixed by its file name; then the literal bytes policy, a NUL byte, and the exact bytes of .agents/worktree-policy.toml, or <default> when that file is absent
state_digest.relevance: a document participates only when it binds the plan allocation or branch: allocation_id match, integration-intent source_allocations or source_branches, release-intent integration_allocation_id, release-plan or release-receipt branch, publication-receipt source_results source_allocation_id, and authority_files by allocation_id
state_digest.excluded: branch-retirement-plans and branch-retirement-receipts never participate, so recording local completion does not invalidate the remote half of the same plan
state_digest.policy_authority: <canonical repository path>/.agents/worktree-policy.toml is the only policy source

verify.lock: shared repository lock held for the whole observation; no state is written, so callers run it before taking an exclusive retirement execution lock
verify.plan_schema_binding: plan.schema_version is the retirement authority pin; this contract surface is branch_retirement_contract.version

verdicts.RETIREMENT_EXECUTABLE: the plan's exact expected OID may be CAS-compared now
verdicts.RETIREMENT_STALE: authority or OID movement invalidated the plan; replan instead of mutating
verdicts.RETIREMENT_BLOCKED: occupancy, lease, intent, transaction, ancestry or unattested absence forbids mutation
verdicts.RETIREMENT_OPERATION_COMPLETE: an immutable receipt already records this operation for this plan

verify.absent_ref: an unattested absent ref is RETIREMENT_BLOCKED with blocker ABSENT_UNATTESTED until a Finalizer summary proves the idempotent already-absent path and branch-retirement-record files the receipt
verify.remote_semantics: remote ref_state observes the local remote-tracking ref; the Finalizer remains authoritative for the actual remote through its own fetch and expected-OID compare-and-delete

eligible_allocations.feature_audit: released allocation with an immutable release receipt and direct ancestry
eligible_allocations.integration: released allocation whose release plan links to the exact remote-verified publication receipt; repository, allocation, candidate, Finalizer and policy target identities must match
eligible_allocations.canonical_transition: explicit branch selector with exactly one complete CANONICAL_TRANSITIONED event in the currently canonical-bound canonical/control-plane record; exact old HEAD and recorded main-before are ancestors of recorded main-after, itself contained in the current policy publication target on the recorded remote; registration CANONICAL_TRANSITION_BACKED and release_receipt_id null

branch_retirement_contract.completion: independent idempotent local and remote receipts; never atomic
branch_retirement_contract.capability_binding: branch_retirement_version stays pinned to plan.schema_version because the deployed Git Finalizer retirement verifier compares that capability against the plan schema; the verify surface is detected through branch_retirement_verify_version and contract_version
compatibility: persisted plan schema stays 1 and v1 plans verify and authorize unchanged under this contract

transition-backed plans add canonical_transition_evidence to identity only when present; it binds the exact history event sha256, old HEAD, main before/after, remote, old owner and old Finalizer identity; canonical is never released and ordinary unregistered refs remain report-only
missing, invalid, ambiguous or drifted transition evidence fails closed; existing checkout, lease, runtime, recovery, intent, transaction and expected-OID gates remain mandatory
branch_retirement_version continues to mirror plan.schema_version for the deployed verifier
branch-retirement-verify keeps its four verdicts and its eight minimum_revalidation names
branch-retirement-plan, -status and -record keep their released payload keys
branch-retirement-record now refuses an operation holding a grant and a completion the Controller cannot observe; a fabricated result was never a valid retirement and no longer files a receipt
receipts gain provenance and result_contract; persisted receipts without them stay valid history
a further verdict, identity field, digest recipe or blocker change requires a new retirement contract version and a new contract_version

execution_authorization.canonicalization: JSON object with keys sorted, ensure_ascii=false, separators (",",":"), UTF-8
execution_authorization.authorization_id: sha256 over the canonical JSON encoding of the identity fields

token.description: a 256-bit Controller-generated capability returned only by authorize and compared constant-time at complete or abandon; it is excluded from the identity so it cannot change the authorization address

execution_authorization.scope: one plan, one operation, one use
binding: controller_state_digest at issuance, using the frozen v1 recipe unchanged
an observation vector of the literal Git facts that recipe cannot see: watched ref to OID, checked-out paths, upstream ref and target, classification and blockers
the compare-and-delete tuple: ref, expected_oid, integrated_ref, expected_integrated_oid, tracking_ref
execution_authorization.settlement: complete takes the exclusive repository lock, re-observes the refs and re-derives the digest, and files a receipt only for exactly one authorized delta: the target ref moved from its expected OID to absent
execution_authorization.abandonment: the token holder, or a settled dead-holder observation, may close a grant; closing never files a receipt because absence alone does not prove who caused it, and writes immutable evidence instead
execution_authorization.fence: while a grant is outstanding: a second grant for the same plan and operation is refused, verify reports RETIREMENT_AUTHORIZATION_ACTIVE for the granted operation only, legacy branch-retirement-record refuses that operation, and MetadataStore.write_record refuses to create a new binding for the granted allocation with RETIREMENT_EXECUTION_ACTIVE
not_claimed: a lock held by the caller: the Controller neither accepts nor verifies a caller lock assertion
prevention of an unauthorized plain-git mutation: it can be refused a receipt, not physically stopped
the remote operation's server-side fact: the Controller observes its own remote-tracking ref only
reported_only_kinds: ATTEST_ABSENT (a translated legacy consumer claim; never a grant, and refused by a grant settle)
execution_authorization.holder: self, or ancestor:<program> resolved from the caller's own process tree; a detached pid is refused with INVALID_HOLDER because naming somebody else's process proves nothing

provenance.AUTHORIZED_EXECUTION: settled through a grant and the Controller's own re-observation
provenance.CONTROLLER_OBSERVED: legacy record where the Controller observed the ref gone and authority intact
provenance.CONSUMER_CLAIM: receipts filed before this contract; persisted history, never re-creatable

execution_authorization.authority_recheck: record re-runs the full governance evaluation and refuses with EXECUTION_GOVERNANCE_MOVED when any authority_blockers entry appeared after the plan; ref-derived codes are expected from a deletion and are not refused
execution_authorization.grant_document_layout: <git-common-dir>/worktree-controller/v1/branch-retirement-authorizations/<authorization_id>.json, with immutable <authorization_id>-abandoned.json evidence written beside it; the directory is not in the state digest, so a grant cannot invalidate the plan it authorizes
execution_authorization.abandonment_authority: the execution token only; holder liveness is reported by inspect as information because flock dies with the process while the mutation may never have run
execution_authorization.fence_scope: the allocation half of the fence is enforced at the single binding chokepoint; the branch half is prevented by acquire's existing BRANCH_EXISTS rule and detected at settlement by the observation vector, because a metadata record carries no branch name
execution_authorization.expiry: expiry means the claim needs verification, never that the work is done: an expired grant still fences occupancy, still requires settle or abandon with the token, and a settlement after expiry is recorded as grant_expired_at_settle rather than refused

plan_recipe.promise: the recipe is what a grant later binds, so a consumer can prepare from the plan alone; it names no consumer product and carries no digest recipe

activation_layout_migration.previous_layout: explicit namespace, policy path and installed entrypoint SHA256 bindings
activation_layout_migration.writer_transition: schema 1 holder.provider to schema 2 holder.client_id; identity and authority preserved
blockers: live evidence bound to previous paths
activation_layout_migration.rollback: exact receipt and digest; inverse layout and lease conversion without replay
activation_layout_migration.retirement: explicit finish-layout after real client acceptance

host_managed_writer_session.access_option: --access read|exec|write; write requires --target <absolute-path>; writer-session check accepts the same options

host_handoff_continuation_contract.producer: writer-session host-check <actual-caller-path> | writer-session check <client> <path> <holder> --session-id <id>, each with --access read|exec|write [--target <absolute-path>]
host_handoff_continuation_contract.admission: CONTINUATION_GRANTED with code HOST_HANDOFF_CONTINUATION; exit 0 only for GRANTED or CONTINUATION_GRANTED
host_handoff_continuation_contract.applies_to: the exact live holder of the current lease on its own HANDOFF_READY or PRESERVED feature allocation, with no foreign runtime binding and no frozen HEAD drift
host_handoff_continuation_contract.write_targets: outside Controller governance; another checkout whose writer lease this same live process (PID, boot ID, start ticks) holds and whose feature-write guard allows it; or an ACTIVE integration candidate whose source_allocations include the frozen allocation and whose integration-write guard allows it
host_handoff_continuation_contract.performance: entitlement checks evaluate the write guard without the full status scan and decode repository metadata once
host_handoff_continuation_contract.handoff_scope: handoff --scope-changed records the exact paths changed since the publication base for an unscoped feature task; an integration-ready handoff of unscoped changed work succeeds with warning MISSING_HANDOFF_SCOPE because integration-enqueue requires a scope
host_handoff_continuation_contract.rollout_requirements: a consumer may report required_controller_capabilities {name: minimum}; activation and rollback refuse a target runtime that does not advertise each minimum
host_handoff_continuation_contract.fence: the frozen checkout, other governed checkouts, other repositories and checks without --access keep the original refusal; leases, bindings and lifecycle are never mutated
host_handoff_continuation_contract.consumer: a host maps each tool call to one access class and target; authority remains this Controller decision

tracked_source_preservation_contract.scope: unstaged modified tracked regular files only
tracked_source_preservation_contract.reconstruction: base HEAD tree plus exact raw file overlay

tracked_source_cleanup_contract.scope: exact receipt-covered modified tracked files to bound HEAD
tracked_source_cleanup_contract.execution_precondition: current preservation receipt, generation, HEAD, index, file and parent identities match
tracked_source_cleanup_contract.partial_failure: retain immutable evidence and transaction; no replay or release
tracked_source_cleanup_contract.no_commit_completion: current completion references archival evidence; no historical handoff assertion
tracked_source_cleanup_contract.allocation_release: separate existing lifecycle with source and generation reverification

transaction_conflict_contract.conflict_scope: nonterminal same-allocation or overlapping resource scopes under the repository mutation lock
transaction_conflict_contract.historical_terminal: exact supported immutable terminal evidence; retained journals may coexist

tracked_source_no_action_recovery_contra.scope: transaction-scope refusal before tracked source action
tracked_source_no_action_recovery_contra.precondition: empty actions and checks, no action evidence, exact source/index/HEAD/parents/preservation, runtime authority PASS
tracked_source_no_action_recovery_contra.successor: new single-use attempt identity bound by immutable reconciliation

session_end_selector_contract.selection: writer leases in that repository whose recorded holder equals the resolved live holder exactly, including client and session identity
session_end_selector_contract.action: release each exact lease, then the unchanged reconcile-session route: ACTIVE feature/audit is retained, HANDOFF_READY gets its release intent
session_end_selector_contract.exit: default always 0; use session-closeout/v1 per-allocation outcomes and summary, or --require-complete

retention_convergence_contract.authority: repository policy [convergence] delegated to the [reconciler] actor; apply refuses any other actor
retention_convergence_contract.plan: default is a read-only report; --apply acts
retention_convergence_contract.candidates: clean attached feature/audit checkouts in ACTIVE (dormant only), RETAINED, HANDOFF_READY, RELEASE_READY, ARCHIVED or NO_CHANGE_COMPLETED, plus hotfix HANDOFF_READY, without writer lease, live process, binding, publication lease or active integration lineage

routes.close-delivered: HEAD, base and task commit contained in the publication branch; waits grace_minutes
routes.release-published-handoff: feature/audit/hotfix frozen handoff equals HEAD and is published; waits grace_minutes; a hotfix with an unregistered .venv waits for its owner attestation
routes.release-retained-handoff: policy release_unintegrated_handoffs only: unpublished integration-ready feature/audit/hotfix handoff whose task, handoff and Finalizer identities, local branch and remote-tracking branch all equal HEAD and that no open integration intent references; waits the dynamic idle threshold; integration-enqueue later resolves the source branch from its release receipt while that branch still equals the handoff
routes.archive-retained: unfinished commits stay on the retained branch; waits the dynamic idle threshold
routes.park: dormant ACTIVE feature/audit allocation without lease, process, binding or publication lease; waits idle_hours_max (never shortened by pressure), then follows the fitting route

retention_convergence_contract.dynamic_threshold: idle_hours_max while registered <= live + standing_reserve, otherwise max(idle_hours_min, idle_hours_max / pressure^2)
retention_convergence_contract.resources: an unregistered root .venv is registered as reproducible python-venv; release teardown preflight still decides
retention_convergence_contract.admission: acquire starts a detached pass in its own session and reports CONVERGENCE_SCHEDULED as retention_convergence; it never blocks or slows acquire
retention_convergence_contract.serialization: applying passes take a non-blocking per-repository host lock; a concurrent pass returns CONVERGENCE_BUSY
retention_convergence_contract.report: decision.reason and outcome_counts summarize every finding outcome; RELEASED findings carry receipt_id (the ReleaseReceipt) and release_plan_id; ATTENTION_REQUIRED findings carry owner_action
retention_convergence_contract.pass_report: each applying pass records RUNNING then COMPLETED or FAILED beside the pass lock; a dry run returns it as decision.last_applied_pass, and RUNNING with a free lock reads as INTERRUPTED; it is an observation, never release evidence

retained_archive_contract.plan: read-only --dry-run binds the exact clean retained checkout, branch, owner and actor
retained_archive_contract.apply: requires --plan-id; writes an immutable receipt before CAS transition RETAINED to ARCHIVED
retained_archive_contract.physical_removal: separate guarded release/gc-apply; branch and task evidence remain
retained_archive_contract.compatibility: ARCHIVED requires retained_archive_version 1; older runtimes fail closed

delivered_closeout_contract.plan: read-only --dry-run binds exact record, HEAD, branch, recorded owner, actor and live publication OID
delivered_closeout_contract.apply: requires --plan-id; writes an immutable closeout receipt before CAS transition RETAINED or legacy PRESERVED to RELEASE_READY
delivered_closeout_contract.scope: clean attached feature/audit checkout with all historical commit evidence in live publication and no lease, runtime, binding, uncleaned resource, frozen handoff or integration obligation
delivered_closeout_contract.historical_task_evidence: unchanged; original record retained in the receipt
delivered_closeout_contract.physical_removal: separate existing release/gc-apply, with receipt, runtime and publication revalidation
delivered_closeout_contract.compatibility: RELEASE_READY requires delivered_closeout_version 1; older runtimes fail closed on this lifecycle

cleanup_hardlink_topology_contract.outside_scope: names never searched or modified; exact external link-count remainder
cleanup_hardlink_topology_contract.evidence: complete in-scope inode/member/content map; pinned shared inode content and metadata before/after each unlink
cleanup_hardlink_topology_contract.observation_scope: unlink boundary, not global exclusion of external writers

cleanup_resume_attempt_contract.absent_completion: immutable underlying refusal; no receipt path constructed
cleanup_resume_attempt_contract.supersession: explicit reconcile-attempt, exact filesystem/topology/preservation/runtime validation, new attempt identity

typed_cleanup_no_action_contract.requires: exact pending journal, no action evidence, absent receipt or exact pre-action refusal receipt, current scope identity/content, owner/Git/runtime checks
typed_cleanup_no_action_contract.refusal_receipt: immutable SHA-256 binding; original failure retained; no action/runtime checkpoint
typed_cleanup_no_action_contract.terminal: TYPED_ATTEMPT_SUPERSEDED; original journal unchanged; fresh cleanup required
typed_cleanup_no_action_contract.automatic_authority: existing exact approved release intent only

metadata_reference_relocation_contract.recovery_execution: installed Controller only; separate append-only reconciliation
metadata_reference_relocation_contract.rollback: blocked after new or changed cleanup evidence; preserve history
producers: activation_layout.LayoutMigration, which renames the whole namespace and carries the record with it
namespace_migration.migrate_namespace, which merges a per-repository namespace under the destination lock and writes the record only after the previous root is gone

published_handoff_resource_registration_.target: HANDOFF_READY hotfix without a pending release intent; existing ignored task-local root .venv only
published_handoff_resource_registration_.owner: exact recorded owner and record CAS; creator must be handoff-owner-attestation:<owner>, not an asserted original creation command
published_handoff_resource_registration_.identity: clean attached linked checkout; exact nonempty task/handoff/Finalizer HEAD and record ID; retained branch and original base ancestry; no recovery lineage
published_handoff_resource_registration_.publication: live policy ls-remote equals tracking ref; exact frozen HEAD and original base are ancestors of publication
published_handoff_resource_registration_.blockers: writer/publication leases, bindings, managed or observed runtime, scan uncertainty, open integration obligations, unrelated historical source handoff, nonterminal or unknown scoped transactions
published_handoff_resource_registration_.resource: reproducible on-release python-venv; existing tracking/ignore/type checks and unchanged reproducible teardown preflight
published_handoff_resource_registration_.proof: append published_handoff_resource_registration to the new DISPOSABLE_REGISTERED history event; preserve old history and frozen fields
published_handoff_resource_registration_.effect: metadata classification only; no source changes, reopen, cleanup, business completion or new release authority
published_handoff_resource_registration_.release: existing owner-authorized release rechecks current resource and runtime evidence; automatic convergence roles unchanged

typed_cleanup_verify_boundary_contract.boundary: resource-clean verifies hardlink topology before marking an action STARTED; a topology refusal leaves no action evidence
typed_cleanup_verify_boundary_contract.legacy_refusal: a pre-1.28.0 journal whose first action is FAILED_OR_PARTIAL with failure HARDLINK_TOPOLOGY_BLOCKED, later actions PENDING, and only <cleanup-actions>/<transaction>/0000-before.json bound to the plan topology is accepted by reconcile-typed and rollout-check
typed_cleanup_verify_boundary_contract.receipt: the refusal receipt may carry exactly one runtime check for the first resource; reconciliation binds the BEFORE receipt as verify_boundary_receipt
typed_cleanup_verify_boundary_contract.proof: unchanged typed resource evidence (whole-tree path, device, inode, mode, size and mtime) and exact in-scope inode, member and content topology prove no deletion began
typed_cleanup_verify_boundary_contract.external_churn: ctime and nlink drift is accepted only on inodes with links outside the scope before and after; in-scope-only inodes stay exact

resource_admission_contract.authority: shared per-user host ledger; repository ownership remains independent
resource_admission_contract.checkout_counts: statistics only across all readable policy schemas
resource_admission_contract.queue: durable WAITING without a writer; attempted mutations require terminal evidence; positive no-effect recovery archives the original journal before ordinary re-admission
resource_admission_contract.release: runtime clearance settles execution; verified allocation release receipts also reconcile historical writer-only reservations
resource_admission_contract.writer_ownership: writer grants do not reserve or bind execution; launchers admit before launch and bind existing runtime occupancy
resource_admission_contract.diagnostics: writer_leases_recorded counts ownership; runtime_occupied and the live_executions compatibility alias count runtime-bound allocations, not observed process liveness
resource_admission_contract.pressure: filesystem bytes/inodes plus growth/preservation; memory budget and CPU/memory/IO PSI hysteresis
resource_admission_contract.rollback: target must support every nonterminal request capability
resource_admission_contract.host_execution_scope: admission refuses the home root and its ancestors; historical home-scoped rows close only through typed dead-holder recovery
resource_admission_contract.host_execution_recovery: read-only inspect publishes the canonical holder bytes, SHA-256 digest, dead-holder observation and terminal-evidence template; typed clear re-verifies every fact and writes one immutable receipt; a provably absent target releases through the same authority as an orphan

governance_contract.gc_plan: read-only classification of all Git registrations; each candidate independently probes its checkout repo path, .git entry, Git common dir and lock path, reporting UNKNOWN for inaccessible mount evidence rather than inheriting another candidate's mount state; each candidate includes candidate_reason, session, lifecycle_observation, stale_facts, orphan_facts, filesystem_health, namespace_health and blocking_facts; --path with owner release or release intent runs ReleasePlan preflight, while an owner-reviewed physically missing no-change audit can produce a registration-prune plan
governance_contract.gc_apply: one reviewed target at a time; rechecks plan identity under the repository lock and routes ordinary checkout removal through release with ReleasePlan and ReleaseReceipt; a target already released by exactly the reviewed ReleasePlan returns that receipt as ALREADY_RELEASED after release re-verifies it, while a release by any other plan stays GC_PLAN_DRIFT naming its receipt; or removes only a missing no-change audit registration through a recoverable registration-prune transaction and receipt
governance_contract.plan_identity: ordinary release: SHA-256 of canonical JSON ReleasePlan fields excluding timestamped created_at and plan_id; registration prune: SHA-256 of repository, allocation, missing path, admin key, HEAD, owner, record version and preserving publication ref identity; both require no writer or publication lease
governance_contract.capacity: observe only: active and retained counts cover feature/audit linked worktrees and use their policy slot limits; total counts all Git registrations and uses hard_limit; no admission change
governance_contract.lifecycle_observation: status and gc-plan report recorded owner, lifecycle, session, runtime_sessions, lease, heartbeat, status, stale_facts, orphan_facts, integrity_facts and advisory_only; orphan_observations reports repository-level findings; host session health is UNKNOWN without independent evidence; lease renewal is not an independent heartbeat and observations change no lifecycle, release eligibility or GC authority
governance_contract.doctor_mounts: repo, .git entry, Git common dir, existing lock and lock parent are probed in the caller namespace; current and optional namespace.peer report RW, READ_ONLY or UNKNOWN, plus lock_shape, lock_writable and lock_access_errno; --namespace-pid on doctor, status or gc-plan compares a selected process namespace through its root
governance_contract.status_diagnosis: successful status responses include mount_diagnostics and environment_diagnosis; on a status failure the CLI retains the classified error code, and doctor is the detailed mount-evidence entry point
governance_contract.doctor_diagnosis: mount_diagnostics.environment and top-level environment_diagnosis have code HEALTHY, MOUNT_NAMESPACE_MISMATCH, FILESYSTEM_PERMISSION or UNKNOWN with evidence in facts; doctor decision.primary_diagnosis is MOUNT_NAMESPACE_MISMATCH, FILESYSTEM_PERMISSION, UNKNOWN, CONTROLLER_LOCK_AUTHORITY, CONTROLLER_METADATA or NONE; only known different RW mount vectors establish mismatch, environment faults take precedence over Controller lock attribution, and no diagnostic infers sandbox source or repairs mounts
governance_contract.storage: no new metadata documents or directories; existing release plans, receipts and audit remain authoritative

namespace_migration_contract.status: stable in 1.11.0; namespace-migration/v1 identity is unchanged and runtime replay and evidence checks are hardened after the 1.8.0 audit; storage-layout/v4 declares the already existing registration-prune receipt directory without moving data; no production namespace migration is implied
namespace_migration_contract.preflight: unfinished journals and transactions in either namespace block the transition; the advisory plan defers that question to the fence rather than queueing behind a writer, and reports preflight as under_fence
namespace_migration_contract.authority_switch: repo.json is the only file that makes a namespace authoritative, so it lands last by rename; the destination copy is re-digested against the prepared identity before and after the switch
namespace_migration_contract.compatibility: read-only verbs, retirement plans, receipts and every released contract name are unchanged; the legacy namespace is never discovered at runtime, so an unmigrated repository keeps reporting NAMESPACE_UNMANAGED rather than partial state

critical_section.fence: an exclusive flock on the destination repo.lock, created before any content lands, is held for the whole transition
critical_section.legacy_lock: held exclusively without waiting; a caller that holds it is an activation in flight, and waiting there would invert that flow's lock order, so the migration fails closed with NAMESPACE_BUSY instead
critical_section.not_claimed: the fence serializes Controller and activation writers only; a process that ignores repo.lock is outside this contract
critical_section.why_destination: adopt, acquire and integration-enqueue bootstrap metadata with create=True under that same lock, so a concurrent verb queues instead of minting a second repository identity beside the tree being moved

durability.legacy_removal: directories are removed only when empty and the namespace root only after its lock, so unexplained content fails closed with NAMESPACE_RESIDUE
durability.per_document: a document moves only while its planned source bytes match; a complete converted lease is published atomically and an interrupted rewrite leaves only ignored scratch; a destination copy is accepted only when it matches the planned target, except an explicitly planned schema rewrite
durability.prepared_receipt: write-once before destructive work; records identity, source/current/target manifest, lease conversions and policy move so replay can use the original CAS after later destination writes
durability.receipts: write-once 0400 documents under namespace-migrations/, keyed by plan id; a settled receipt makes an exact replay idempotent and an unsettled prepared receipt is reported for recovery
durability.relocation_record: metadata-reference-relocation/v1 evidence is written only after the legacy root is gone, which is when the frozen reference resolver requires the previous root to be absent

identity.canonicalization: sha256 over the canonical JSON encoding of these fields, exactly as preservation._sha encodes them
identity.compare_and_set: namespace-migrate refuses unless the caller presents the exact observed plan id; a new transition re-derives it inside the fence, while an unsettled transition replays only from its matching prepared witness
identity.plan_id: SHA-256 of the released identity fields; a prepared receipt preserves the original identity through move, rewrite and later mutable destination writes, and a different requested id is refused

namespace_migration_contract.purpose: the only supported entry for the historical <git-common-dir>/codex-worktree/v1 namespace; callers never copy, edit or delete namespace JSON

scenarios.NAMESPACE_ALREADY_CURRENT: the legacy namespace is absent and no prepared transition is unsettled; an exact no-op CAS writes no receipt, while a settled transition is reported idempotently through its original receipt
scenarios.NAMESPACE_CONFLICT: both namespaces hold the same path with content that is neither equal nor one document's two schemas; nothing moves and no receipt is written
scenarios.NAMESPACE_CONVERGENCE_REQUIRED: both namespaces hold equivalent content, or the destination holds a document in a form the runtime cannot read; redundant legacy copies clear and the destination is rewritten to the authoritative form
scenarios.NAMESPACE_MIGRATION_REQUIRED: content exists only in the legacy namespace; it moves
scenarios.NAMESPACE_UNMANAGED: neither namespace exists; there is no metadata to migrate

namespace_migration_contract.recovery: namespace-migration-plan remains read-only and reports recovery_required plus the original plan id for an unsettled PREPARED receipt; namespace-migrate requires that exact id, checks source and immutable evidence, tolerates post-switch mutable Controller records, and completes relocation evidence and SETTLED receipt without a second transition

closed_lifecycle_query_contract.cursor: exclusive immutable release_receipt_id in ascending lexical order
closed_lifecycle_query_contract.owner_authority: immutable release plan at closure, never an integration publisher or current checkout owner
closed_lifecycle_query_contract.task_authority: existing release intent, otherwise retained allocation record
closed_lifecycle_query_contract.publication_authority: immutable publication receipt source_results; join source allocation and exact frozen source handoff independently of mutable integration intent
closed_lifecycle_query_contract.semantics: checkout release proves resource closure, not publication or business completion; no history backfill, mutation, remote access, database, or daemon
closed_lifecycle_query_contract.unavailable_evidence: null or INCOMPLETE; contradictory linked identities fail HISTORY_EVIDENCE_CONFLICT

source_release_summary_contract.completion_precondition: unique COMPLETE closed lifecycle evidence matching frozen source branch, handoff and Finalizer identity, current publication association, and no live binding
source_release_summary_contract.semantics: checkout closure observation only; no new release authority or historical mutation; live release reconciliation retains its original status, result and blocker

tracked_source_progress_recovery_contrac.precondition: proper recorded restore prefix with a nonempty preserved remainder, complete before/after/check chain, current restored bytes/inodes and preserved remainder, HEAD/index/parents/generation/runtime authority PASS
tracked_source_progress_recovery_contrac.started_action: current baseline match only; historical status remains ACTION_STARTED
tracked_source_progress_recovery_contrac.rollout: only verified terminal evidence; unresolved partial attempt remains BLOCK
tracked_source_progress_recovery_contrac.rollback: unaware runtimes remain blocked by existing rollout gate

multiple_preservation_cleanup_contract.input: primary pair plus equally sized repeatable additional pairs; reject duplicate receipts, overlapping source paths or any invalid coverage
multiple_preservation_cleanup_contract.identity: all normalized source-relative proof rows and per-resource evidence are bound by plan_id, journal and immutable receipt
multiple_preservation_cleanup_contract.guards: existing allocation, owner/CAS, Git, all-resource, runtime, lease, binding, retained-ref and source-cleanup gates remain mandatory
multiple_preservation_cleanup_contract.source_verification: each action rechecks its own coverage and full hardlink topology; only previously COMPLETED source paths may use destination-only coverage and must remain absent
multiple_preservation_cleanup_contract.release: all actions completed and every preserved source absent with every immutable generation verified against exact allocation identity
multiple_preservation_cleanup_contract.interrupted_recovery: prepare-multiple with exact original journal/receipt SHA-256; completed prefix and never-started pending suffix only; full original proof set and immutable historical evidence retained
multiple_preservation_cleanup_contract.single_input_compatibility: existing single receipt contract, plan and receipt shape remain unchanged

aborted_integration_preserved_cleanup_co.eligible: unpublished integration allocation in INTEGRATION_ABORTED with exact owner, HEAD, record CAS and retained branch; every removed tree has exact immutable preservation coverage
aborted_integration_preserved_cleanup_co.quarantine: direct cleanup stays refused; only the existing explicit owner/CAS integration-abort transition may abort a quarantined candidate, preserving quarantine and failure history
aborted_integration_preserved_cleanup_co.abort_identity: new abort history pins receipt ID and raw SHA-256; legacy single exact matching receipt remains supported; missing, changed or ambiguous evidence blocks
aborted_integration_preserved_cleanup_co.generated_paths: no Astro or directory-name allowlist; ignored and untracked does not mean disposable; even recognized disposable trees require preservation in this lifecycle
aborted_integration_preserved_cleanup_co.lease_and_runtime: any recorded writer lease including expired, publication authority, bindings, managed runtime, uncertain scans and unresolved transactions block; no lease is reclaimed here
aborted_integration_preserved_cleanup_co.admission: request identity and reservation stay unchanged until guarded allocation release; only verified release evidence settles the old budget before a changed-source intent can be claimed
aborted_integration_preserved_cleanup_co.source_identity: unchanged-source retries keep their existing retry contract; changed sources require their own frozen reviewed intent, never source replacement or queue priority inheritance
aborted_integration_preserved_cleanup_co.repeat: consumed live-source preservation inputs remain refused; a fresh empty cleanup plan verifies completed receipts without deletion; guarded release has its existing exact-request replay
aborted_integration_preserved_cleanup_co.result: cleanup only; never publication, source adoption, branch retirement or task completion

multiple_preservation_recovery_contract.input: exact original transaction id, journal SHA-256, failed completion receipt SHA-256, owner, path and record CAS
multiple_preservation_recovery_contract.precondition: nonempty exact completed action prefix and nonempty never-started pending suffix; all before/after action references and topology transitions verified; no suffix action evidence
multiple_preservation_recovery_contract.proof_set: entire original normalized preservation evidence set; no single-receipt downgrade or omitted generation
multiple_preservation_recovery_contract.historical_metadata: immutable recovery record freezes the exact allocation owner/CAS/history and complete verified official generation metadata references with raw SHA-256; terminal verification rechecks their unchanged complete set, including older superseded generations
multiple_preservation_recovery_contract.released_checkout: absence is accepted only with exact official release plan, receipt and frozen allocation history; live source/root/ancestor and deletion guards remain unchanged
multiple_preservation_recovery_contract.execution: existing guarded cleanup runner uses a new transaction UUID for the pending suffix; completed prefix never replayed
multiple_preservation_recovery_contract.guards: exact allocation, owner, HEAD, record CAS, branch, root and ancestor identities, preserved generations, all resources, topology, Git, retained refs, runtime, leases, bindings and transaction authority
multiple_preservation_recovery_contract.terminal: append-only exact composite of the original completed prefix and successful successor action chain; original journal and failed receipt remain byte-identical
multiple_preservation_recovery_contract.interrupted_successor: never replay a started suffix attempt; only exact successful completion may finish a missing terminal receipt
multiple_preservation_recovery_contract.rollback: unaware runtimes remain blocked through the retained original multi cleanup journal

preservation_supersession_contract.authority: one exact allocation and owner with verified frozen handoff, formal reopen and new frozen handoff history
preservation_supersession_contract.baseline: same source-relative path and original root/ancestor chain; fully verified current preservation plus actual completed action may cover older generations through the formal lineage
preservation_supersession_contract.old_evidence: every official generation metadata is verified and retained; absence alone grants no cleanup authority

retained_typed_cleanup_contract.preservation_admission: exact allocation, owner, HEAD and record CAS; retained ref and lineage required
retained_typed_cleanup_contract.cleanup_input: existing primary and paired additional preservation receipt options; no second composition family
retained_typed_cleanup_contract.guards: existing cleanliness, writer, runtime, binding, all-resource, integration and transaction gates remain mandatory
retained_typed_cleanup_contract.result: cleanup only; task completion, archival and physical release remain separate
retained_typed_cleanup_contract.archive_evidence: freeze actual completed cleanup receipt IDs, paths and raw SHA256 values
retained_typed_cleanup_contract.release_bridge: verified archive before-record identity to after-record CAS exactly +1; reverify frozen immutable receipts
retained_typed_cleanup_contract.partial_failure: preserve original journal and immutable receipt; no multi replay or downgrade

no_change_cleanup_closeout_contract.future_completion: complete-no-change freezes the exact before-record, complete transition event and successful cleanup receipt ID/path/raw-SHA256 set; one normal +1 transition pins its write-once completion receipt
no_change_cleanup_closeout_contract.recovery_inputs: exact path, owner, original completion CAS, completion receipt ID/raw SHA256 and repeatable paired successful cleanup receipt IDs/raw SHA256; dry-run plus expected-plan-id
no_change_cleanup_closeout_contract.legacy: one unique old no-change completion and its exact original +1 transition; append-only recovery adds one normal +1 history event, never rewrites old evidence or replays deletion
no_change_cleanup_closeout_contract.replay: while the checkout remains registered, the same original request returns the same receipt without another CAS transition; changed identity or additional history fails closed; after release use normal release replay or exact lifecycle-history
no_change_cleanup_closeout_contract.release: reverify every frozen raw byte digest and derive the full original record through exact transitions before applying unchanged exact-CAS cleanup verification
no_change_cleanup_closeout_contract.guards: all Git, owner, role, lineage, lease, binding, runtime, editable, resource and scoped transaction guards remain mandatory

preservation_leaf_contract.scope: selected exact ignored source-relative path; no tracked parent or sibling removal
preservation_leaf_contract.identity: original source and full ancestor identities bound to immutable plan and verified immediately before cleanup
preservation_leaf_contract.symlink: preserve literal link text; never follow or remove its destination
preservation_leaf_contract.failure: unsupported callbacks and changed ancestor, source, environment or hardlink identity fail closed

integration_publication_execution_contra.framing: UTF-8 JSON lines; this command does not emit the ordinary status envelope
integration_publication_execution_contra.lock_owner: Controller; one exclusive repository lock spans verify, authorize, consumer push and producer completion observation
integration_publication_execution_contra.completion: Controller reobserves the exact remote candidate and returns execution evidence; lease-complete persists the existing publication receipt and owns lifecycle/lease/release changes
integration_publication_execution_contra.recovery: Reuse the same candidate, lease and run; an already-published candidate is observed without another push, including after lease expiry
integration_publication_execution_contra.failure: Missing authority, protocol drift, disconnect, timeout or an unverified remote fails closed; observe the live remote before retrying an interrupted mutation
integration_publication_execution_contra.threat_model: Trusted local caller and OS; no claim of protection from arbitrary same-UID process interference

integration_retry_contract.admission: exact owner, ATTENTION_REQUIRED, aborted candidate with complete release proof, no publication or active authority, unchanged frozen source/scope
integration_retry_contract.plan: read-only dry-run plus expected-plan-id CAS binds failed intent, immutable failure evidence, source records, remote-tracking main and queue evidence
integration_retry_contract.retry: reuse original intent ID, source, scope and enqueue sequence; increment attempt, clear old candidate validation and re-enter normal preparation, validation and publication
integration_retry_contract.prerequisite: one unclaimed later intent with strict source-ancestor proof may inherit the failed parent scheduling position; immutable queue sequences and independent scope remain unchanged; formal prerequisite publication/release precedes retry
integration_retry_contract.evidence: append-only intent history retains the full old failure/abort/release evidence and prior candidate identities; no rewrite or second tracker

integration_conflict_resolution_contract.retry: integration-retry also accepts exact unallocated INTEGRATION_CONFLICT_BLOCKED history; original owner/source/scope/queue and plan CAS remain mandatory
integration_conflict_resolution_contract.retried_attempts: v2 judges the attempt after the last PREPARATION_RETRY_QUEUED: it must be unclaimed, every earlier claimed attempt must have ended in PREPARATION_ABORTED, and only RELEASED earlier candidates may remain
integration_conflict_resolution_contract.claim: integration-claim --intent-id ID --resolve-conflicts verifies an actual single-source conflict, honors queue/capacity and allocates the pinned main with a pending frozen merge identity
integration_conflict_resolution_contract.resolution: caller resolves only frozen scope and commits via Finalizer; integration-resolve requires exact owner/record/head, clean checkout, exact main/source merge parents and unchanged source evidence
integration_conflict_resolution_contract.validation: resolution only binds a new candidate revision; fresh tests, Snapshot, integration-validate, live-main publication CAS and release remain mandatory
integration_conflict_resolution_contract.failure: unknown failures, wrong owner, stale plan, live candidates, source drift, extra parents/commits, dirty checkout and out-of-scope changes fail closed

exited_holder_release_contract.command: writer-lease-release with the exact recorded holder identity and --lease-id
exited_holder_release_contract.applies_to: a lease whose holder process has exited (for example reaped by a runtime), whose process group has no surviving member and whose checkout no other process (besides the caller and its ancestors) still uses
exited_holder_release_contract.result: WRITER_LEASE_RELEASED with holder_exited true; allocation lifecycle and work are untouched
exited_holder_release_contract.refusals: a missing or different lease ID, a different identity, surviving children or another process in the checkout keep the lease (WRITER_LEASE_MISMATCH)

session_admission_contract.admit: session-admit runs plan, acquire and execution-admit in one process for a new feature allocation from the canonical checkout; any other start returns SESSION_ADMISSION_FALLBACK without changes
session_admission_contract.bind: session-bind runs writer-lease-acquire for the exact live holder, the holder-aware write-guard and the runtime binding add in one process; a later Controller or filesystem error attempts to release the granted lease and reports lease_outcome; failed release retains the exact lease and holder identity for recovery
session_admission_contract.guards: each step is the existing command's function with unchanged guards, journals, receipts and record-version CAS; only the intermediate repository status is omitted
session_admission_contract.convergence: the admission-triggered detached retention pass starts after admission and is skipped while a pass runs or within 300 seconds of the last started pass
session_admission_contract.fallback: hosts without this capability, or on SESSION_ADMISSION_FALLBACK, use the individual commands

requirements: native socket peer matches recorded shared daemon
exact archived thread notLoaded and absent from loaded list
no remaining checkout references or associated uncertainty

recovery_guidance_contract.observation: shared repository lock; exact current allocation/owner/task/authority/path/branch/HEAD/CAS and original intent identity
recovery_guidance_contract.authority: read-only; execution_authority=false, execution_guards_checked=false, mutation_performed=false; no eligibility, business completion or publication assertion
recovery_guidance_contract.steps: next_steps[].argv is a structured argument list for only the next observed formal step; reobserve_after_each_step=true; never predict future CAS or compute a consumer digest
recovery_guidance_contract.blocked: clean unchanged BLOCKED integration -> quarantine -> reobserve QUARANTINED -> formal abort -> guarded release dry-run -> exact cleanup/release proof -> original intent retry dry-run/public plan_id -> normal claim/conflict resolution/fresh validation
recovery_guidance_contract.terminal: a published RELEASED intent requires complete matching immutable release and REMOTE_VERIFIED publication evidence; terminal_status=PUBLISHED_RELEASED offers only lifecycle-history inspection, never retry or business completion; incomplete or drifted evidence stays blocked
recovery_guidance_contract.fences: dirty/unknown files, recorded writer/publication leases, bindings, transaction obligations and source/scope/HEAD drift never authorize cleanup or an alternate request; diagnostic warnings remain observations
recovery_guidance_contract.doctor: PASS proves metadata integrity, not lifecycle or publication eligibility

session_closeout_expectations_contract.entrypoint: worktree-session-end with the full client/session/holder/run selector and repeatable --expected-allocation-id <uuid>
session_closeout_expectations_contract.coverage: inspect all exact-selector and prior observed allocations; expected IDs add proof obligations and never select mutation targets; missing expected IDs settle only through complete matching immutable release proof, otherwise remain pending
session_closeout_expectations_contract.results: expected_allocations joins allocations and previous_allocations in summary; every pending live row has recovery_argv; task_completed remains false
session_closeout_expectations_contract.safety: reobserve identity and record CAS; retained checkpoint/handoff observations with a new writer lease cannot report terminal_complete; --check remains read-only and strict exits remain 2 until complete
session_closeout_expectations_contract.compatibility: additive capability; existing selector, advisory exit, CLI 60 and storage 5 remain compatible

binding_registration_backfill_contract.dry_run: --dry-run lists candidates, refused bindings with typed blockers and a plan_id; apply requires --expected-plan-id equal to the current plan
binding_registration_backfill_contract.selection: live linked bindings without a worktree-registration/v1 document; canonical, orphan and already registered bindings are never touched
requirements: administrative directory is a real directory whose name derives the binding key
Git gitdir pointer names the observed checkout
Git registration (commondir mtime) is no later than record created_at plus 900 seconds
record base_commit, when present, is an ancestor of the checkout HEAD
binding_registration_backfill_contract.writes: the existing worktree-registration/v1 marker and binding-registrations document per candidate; no record, binding, lifecycle or history change
binding_registration_backfill_contract.refused: refused bindings keep their legacy meaning and are reported for owner review

session_closeout_report_contract.prepare: --check is read-only and requires the exact client/session/holder and optional recorded run
session_closeout_report_contract.strict: --check and --require-complete return 2 unless selection is complete and every allocation reports terminal_complete
session_closeout_report_contract.advisory: default exit remains 0; SESSION_ENDED is not a success assertion
session_closeout_report_contract.run_identity: --run-id matches exactly; omission matches only a null run, never a replacement run
session_closeout_report_contract.unknown_files: preserved; dirty or unclassified retained files produce an owner action
session_closeout_report_contract.retry: original selected allocations are persisted as observations before lease release; previous_allocations is read-only and never grants authority; unresolved results remain pending across retries

checkout_owner_action_contract.consumer: match an existing Task binding, re-observe the full identity and CAS, and restore only that owner through normal Controller admission

task_checkpoint_park_contract.source: content-addressed checkpoint persisted by the existing Task; owner attestation, not content verification or task completion
task_checkpoint_park_contract.guards: exact owner/record CAS/HEAD, no writer lease or binding; ACTIVE or already RETAINED feature/audit only
task_checkpoint_park_contract.retention: history records the checkpoint reference; status exposes wait_checkpoint while RETAINED
task_checkpoint_park_contract.release: explicit reviewed archive-retained plan then unchanged guarded release; branches kept, unknown files block
task_checkpoint_park_contract.resume: the Task restores the exact retained HEAD through controlled admission and revalidates context before a new writer
